title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, and Ghana
summary: There are outbreaks of yellow fever in the Nando Region of Burkina Faso, Bounkani Region of Côte d’Ivoire, and the Upper West Region of Ghana.
